opening.quote: That's how it goes, kids. The friends, neighbors, drinking buddies, and partners in crime you love so much when you're young, as the years go by, you just lose touch. You will be shocked, kids, when you discover how easy it is in life to part ways with people forever. That's why, when you find someone you want to keep around, *you do something about it.*
opening.source: Ted Mosby, How I Met Your Mother
opening.note: This line is why these postcards exist. So here I am, doing something about it.

cover.dek: Hawaii, and the reason these postcards exist.

letter.body:
A while ago that line from *How I Met Your Mother* came back to me, and it wouldn't leave. So many of the people I love are now a flight, a time zone or a few busy years away, and I don't want to be the one who lets us drift.

So this is the first of these postcards. Every season I'll send one: what I've been up to, a few photos, and one question for you at the bottom. Please answer it. That's the part I'm most excited about.

This one comes from Hawaii, where I spent [how long] in [which month]. [A line or two about the trip: what you did, what surprised you, what you'll remember.]
